Feature

Feature

App Engine standard environment Node.js

Feature

App Engine standard environment Python

Feature

BigQuery

Feature

The reservation_override_mode and disable_on_demand_billing reservation and billing controls are generally available (GA). You can use these regional options with the ALTER PROJECT SET OPTIONS and ALTER ORGANIZATION SET OPTIONS statements to control whether queries can override assigned reservations to on-demand billing or require reservation slots.

Cloud Run

Feature

Support for the Python 3.15 runtime is in General Availability (GA).

Feature

Support for the Node.js 26 runtime is in General Availability (GA).

Cloud Run functions

Feature

Support for the Node.js 26 runtime is in General Availability (GA).

Feature

Support for the Python 3.15 runtime is in General Availability (GA). This runtime is only available for Cloud Run functions and isn't supported on Cloud Run functions (1st gen).

Filestore

Feature

Small capacity Filestore instances for the zonal service tier are generally available (GA). You can create zonal instances starting at 100 GiB and scale capacity in 1 GiB increments up to 10,239 GiB.

For more information, see Small capacity instances.

Google Kubernetes Engine

Deprecated

Policy Controller is deprecated as of November 12, 2026, and reaches end of support on December 31, 2027. Starting January 31, 2027, you can't enable Policy Controller in fleet host projects that don't already have Policy Controller enabled. Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) blocks upgrades to version 1.39 and later for clusters that have Policy Controller installed. Clusters that run GKE version 1.39 and later don't support Policy Controller. On December 31, 2027, technical support, security patching on GKE version 1.38 and earlier, and the Google Cloud console dashboard for Policy Controller end.

Migrate your admission policies to Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicies, Pod Security Admission, or self-managed Open Policy Agent (OPA) Gatekeeper. For more information, see Migrate from Policy Controller.

Looker

Announcement

You can now compare Conversational Analytics capabilities across multiple platforms to determine the ideal offering for your use case. This guide compares functional, administrative, and security capabilities across the Looker UI, the Looker API, and the Conversational Analytics API.

Feature

Single-hop, self-service migration from a customer-hosted Looker instance to Looker (Google Cloud core) is available in Preview. You can run a unified Python script to export and encrypt your data with a Cloud KMS customer-managed encryption key (CMEK). After you upload the encrypted deliverables to Cloud Storage, you can import them directly without manual handoffs or support tickets.

NetApp Volumes

Announcement

Through December 31, 2026, Google Cloud NetApp Volumes sends email notifications to the Google group for NetApp Volumes maintenance, in addition to Unified Maintenance alerts. After December 31, 2026, NetApp Volumes no longer sends email notifications to the Google group, and Unified Maintenance is the only source of planned maintenance notifications.

For more information, see Monitor and plan for maintenance events.

Feature

Google Cloud NetApp Volumes is integrated with Unified Maintenance. This integration supports the Flex Unified, Flex File, Standard, Premium, and Extreme service levels.

You can view upcoming and past planned maintenance events for your storage pools in Cloud Hub, and track event logs and configure automated alerts in Cloud Logging. For more information, see Monitor and plan for maintenance events.
